mapper.insert: INSERT INTO chat_messages (channel_id, workspace_id, author_id, author_type, content_html) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{workspaceId}, #{authorId}, #{authorType}, #{contentHtml})
mapper.select: SELECT id, channel_id, workspace_id, author_id, author_type, content_html, reply_count, last_reply_at, edited_at, created_at, updated_at FROM chat_messages WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT t.id, t.channel_id, t.author_id, t.author_type, t.content_html, t.reply_count, t.last_reply_at, t.edited_at, t.created_at, u.name AS author_name FROM ( SELECT * FROM chat_messages WHERE channel_id = #{channelId} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) t LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = t.author_id ORDER BY t.created_at ASC, t.id ASC
